task_title: PERF-DUCKBRAIN-002 (bench-script half): 500ms latency assertion + non-zero exit
task_criteria: Bench script asserts the 500ms ceiling and fails loudly: scripts/perf/perf001-list-latency.mjs defines a default PERF_ASSERT_MS=500 latency ceiling and exits non-zero (process.exit(1)) with a machine-readable FAIL summary line when any sample exceeds it; a RED arm proves the gate bites (run with PERF_ASSERT_MS=1 against a daemon -> prints result=FAIL and exits 1); a GREEN arm proves it can pass (PERF_ASSERT_MS above the measured latency -> prints result=PASS and exits 0); the script can target an authenticated daemon by reading a token file named in DUCKBRAIN_API_KEY_FILE and sending it as the x-api-key header (the live :3000 port answers 401 without it), so the live acceptance run in PERF-DUCKBRAIN-002 criterion 3 is executable; the change is confined to the perf script plus one new test that exercises the threshold helper, and pnpm test:run stays green. No production mutation: no namespace data is squashed and no daemon is restarted in this row.

items.detail: Default ceiling: scripts/perf/latency-assertion.mjs:2-3 (`rawCeiling === undefined ? 500 : Number(rawCeiling)`); direct probe printed `default ceiling: {"pass":true,"ceilingMs":500}` and `default breach: {"pass":false,"ceilingMs":500,"namespace":"ns","sampleMs":501}`. FAIL line + exit: scripts/perf/perf001-list-latency.mjs:84-89 (`result=FAIL namespace=... sample_ms=... ceiling_ms=...` then `process.exit(1)`). RED arm run live against :3000 with DUCKBRAIN_API_KEY_FILE=$HOME/.duckbrain/foreman-status.token and PERF_ASSERT_MS=1 -> `/tmp/red3.log`: `result=FAIL namespace=coding-hermes sample_ms=1353.6 ceiling_ms=1` (a direct non-detached run also returned EXIT=1). GREEN arm same daemon, PERF_ASSERT_MS=60000 -> `/tmp/green2.log`: `result=PASS ceiling_ms=60000` and `EXIT=0`. Auth seam: perf001-list-latency.mjs:21-24 reads DUCKBRAIN_API_KEY_FILE and sends `x-api-key`; without it the run dies `Error: coding-hermes run 1: HTTP 401` EXIT=1 (/tmp/noauth.log), with it the same URL answers 200 and the run completes — the token file format (raw 65-byte key, trimmed) matches what src/auth/middleware.ts:201-215 expects. Scope: `git show --name-only HEAD` = scripts/perf/latency-assertion.mjs, scripts/perf/perf001-list-latency.mjs, src/perf/perf-latency-assertion.test.ts, test-counts.json (283/2400 bumped in the same commit). Suite: `npx vitest run` -> `Test Files  283 passed (283)` / `Tests  2400 passed (2400)` / `EXIT=0` (/tmp/fullsuite.log); the new test alone: `Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 4 passed (4)`. No mutation: `git ls-files namespaces` empty and `git status --short namespaces` clean; file counts still 20054 (coding-hermes) / 29088 (fleet-quality), matching the pre-change magnitudes; :3000 /health uptime 58,990s (~16.4h) at review time, i.e. not restarted in this row.
